### Ballina Punx: Hubert Selby Junior Infantry, YOP & Warm Side

![Hubert Selby Junior Infantry](news/hsji.jpg)

The Ballina Punx are back at theNCF for another epic night! Here's the lineup:

#### HUBERT SELBY JUNIOR INFANTRY
Dublin 4 piece that you do not want to miss! Punk/grunge/indie/post-hardcore vibes.

[Check them out on Bandcamp](https://hsji.bandcamp.com/music)

#### YOP
Back with a few more new songs. Maybe one or two from their forthcoming 2nd EP?

[Listen to their music](https://yopballina.bandcamp.com/)

#### WARM SIDE
Young guns from Castlebar making their Ballina debut!

### Event Details
- **Date:** Friday 18th April 2025
- **Time:** Doors @ 9pm
- **Location:** TheNCF Collective, 5 Pearse Street, F26 C925
- **Admission:** €10
- **Note:** BYOB (no glass please)

*Presented by Ballina Punx and theNCF*
